title: ConnectionStatusChangedPayload
description: Payload of the ConnectionStatusChanged platform event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8, §28.18; class: platform; FR-AH.15). Authored by INV-T-2855 (T11), moved here from the per-producer copies INV-T-2853 (T9) first added (STK-61: a platform event's schema is owned by service-runtime alone). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

connection.description: The connection this status concerns, e.g. an outbound feed or adapter name.

state.description: Connection health state, e.g. up, down, degraded (this producer's own vocabulary).

lastFailure.description: The most recent failure, absent when none has occurred since the connection came up.
